description: This file defines the DauxExtension class which implements ConfigurableExtensionInterface to configure a schema and register event listeners for a Markdown content type extension in a documentation tool.

classes.name: DauxExtension
classes.description: Implements a configurable extension for the Markdown environment, allowing schema configuration and event handling.

methods.name: configureSchema
methods.description: Adds a 'daux' schema to the configuration builder with a specific type expectation.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event listener for the DocumentParsedEvent to add an auto table of contents.
